authority: A relay property, not a numerical truth: the covariance an FFM execution call emits is accepted, unmodified, as the INITIAL_COVARIANCE of the next call, and every emitted covariance is exactly symmetric. The seeds are fitted covariances (state, dynamic parameters and covariance at the fit epoch, SI, GCRF) from C2, whose relays FFM 2.0.0 to 2.0.3 refused; the fits are analysis/estimation products on public data, cited per seed.
epochNote: Each seed is carried from this epoch, not its own fit epoch: the module's environment fixtures (tests/fixtures/resident: EOP 2026-08, synthetic space weather 2026-07-31 to 08-09) cover it, and the windows' own environment is not in the module. The GCRF state and covariance are unchanged, so the covariance stays consistent with the orbit it was fitted on.
arcNote: C2's fit track (fit epoch t0 to the handoff E) and its leads: call 1 runs t0 to t0 + 24 h, call 2 the next 24 h.
forces: catalog.mjs fullForceRequest (FFM-1: EGM2008 70x70, Sun, Moon, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, cannonball SRP, Knocke Earth radiation, NRLMSISE-00 drag, IERS 2010 solid tides and relativity, FES2004 30x30), CATALOG_INTEGRATOR (RK78, 1e-14 relative, initial step 30 s, maximum 120 s); analytic STM with the density gradient by finite difference
